title: Coordinated rollout & documentation orchestration for private deployment security primitives
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Goal: deliver a repeatable, audit-friendly rollout package for Private/VPC/on-prem features (RBAC, audit logging, KMS integration) that includes coordinated release notes, legal-approved messaging, support playbooks, and hands-on enablement labs for initial customers. This ticket owns cross-team orchestration for docs, release note templates, internal comms, and post-launch verification steps. Deliverables: release notes bundle, support runbook, enablement lab schedule, customer-facing KB articles, and a validation checklist for security/compliance stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes template completed with legal and privacy sign-off and one example filled for RBAC, KMS, and audit-logs
Support runbook created and reviewed by SRE and Support with triage steps and known limitations
Enablement lab plan scheduled with at least two sessions and training materials linked
Telemetry and SLO dashboard queries for audit-export and KMS failures documented
All documentation links added to a single release artifact folder and stakeholders notified
tasks: Draft canonical release notes template (owner: PM)
Coordinate legal and privacy review on KMS wording (owner: Legal via PM)
Create support runbook: RBAC mapping guide, audit log export troubleshooting, KMS key rotation steps (owner: SRE/Support)
Design enablement lab exercises and customer onboarding checklist (owner: Solutions Engineering)
Prepare internal announcement and engineering playbook for rollback/fallback (owner: PM + Eng)
Localize top-level KB articles for EU/US with required compliance disclaimers (owner: Docs)
Publish release artifact bundle and register in release index (owner: PM)
Post-launch 72-hour verification: validate metrics, customer feedback, and incident backlog (owner: PM + Observability)
Close loop with sales/customer success on Q&A and deferred feature requests (owner: CS)
Run a dry-run enablement session with internal reps (owner: Training)

risk_mitigation: If Legal delays wording, publish a minimal feature notice and schedule a follow-up set of detailed KBs
If KMS integration shows intermittent failures in staging, enable a conservative default (customer KMS opt-in) and document rollback
If audit export retention requirements vary by customer, include configuration examples for common retention policies and link to compliance contacts
Prepare an emergency fallback: route private requests to hosted-compatible model variant for degraded availability scenarios
release_notes_outline: Headline: Private deployment security primitives: RBAC, Audit Export, and KMS connector
Summary: one-paragraph impact for admins and platform engineers
What’s new: bullet list of behaviors and defaults
Upgrade/compatibility notes: configuration required, API changes, breaking considerations
Security & compliance notes: data residency, audit retention, encryption in transit and at rest
How to enable: minimal steps and example CLI/YAML snippets
Support & troubleshooting: links to runbook and common error patterns
Migration considerations: path for existing customers to opt-in without downtime
training_plan: Internal dry-run: 60-minute session for support + SRE with simulated incidents (2025-02-24)
Customer enablement labs: two 90-minute guided sessions with sandbox tenant (2025-02-26, 2025-02-28)
Create a 10-minute explainer video for RBAC mapping and KMS onboarding
Publish quick-check cheat sheet for Support with command snippets and escalation matrix
